name: After § 76
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 76e. Reaffirms that the natural resources of Venezuela and Greenland belong to their peoples and must be managed in line with self-determination, not foreign coercion; calls on the EU institutions and the Member States to oppose any form of pressure, intimidation or interference aimed at securing privileged access to these resources and to ensure that EU external action does not enable or legitimise such practices;
